extraction_instructions: JS calendar backed by the public WP REST post type /wp-json/wp/v2/event (acf.start_date/end_date YYYYMMDD, place, city, external_url). Listing reads that API; webinars (academy.esaic.org) and EDAIC exams are skipped. Own events (congress/course/masterclass) have an esaic.org page with an EUR fee table; endorsed/external events redirect to the organiser site and are built from the API record only.

Elementor page with a 'Schedule Of Upcoming Meetings' table (title, date range, 'Venue, City, Country', optional Information link to a microsite). The page repeats the rows in a mobile layout and lists past meetings below; read the first block only and dedupe. Rows without a link (Innovation Spotlight, later congresses) have no page and are built from the row. 2027 microsites publish no fee table yet.

Drupal 10. The events page is JS-rendered from /jsonapi/index/events (field_event_start/end, field_location, field_link, path alias); the listing reads that JSON in the browser. The flagship The Liver Meeting is NOT in the index: it lives on the /tlm-NN/home microsite (found via the nav link) with fees on /tlm-NN/event-registration. Application-only programmes are skipped; webinars are included when dated (fee read from the LiverLearning page).

CoBlocks Events carousel (JS-rendered) with two blocks: BESS events and third-party events. Slides carry day/month/year spans (ranges like 30-2 / June - July), title, a description span holding the event link, time and location. Slides without a link have no page. Fees for BESS courses sit on a WooCommerce /product/<slug>/ page linked from the event page (price plus Out of stock flag).

Homepage header line '7-9 June 2027 · Liverpool Experience Campus' gives the edition; one event. Registration page lists no amounts (flexible-fee wording only); abstracts page says submission coming soon. Single-congress family (extractors/single_congress.py): one edition shell per run.
